axioms: Axiom tree_lower_bound_root : forall (l : tree Z) (x : Z) (y : Z), (bst l /\ root l x /\ lower_bound l y) -> (y < x).
Axiom tree_upper_bound_root : forall (l : tree Z) (x : Z) (y : Z), (bst l /\ root l x /\ upper_bound l y) -> (y > x).
